CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.job_persisted_projection_sha256(job "Job")
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT (job."companyId" <> '' AND job."sourceId" <> '' AND job."dedupeKey" <> '' AND
        (job."sourceJobId" IS NULL OR job."sourceJobId" <> '') AND
        job."officialTitle" <> '' AND job."officialUrl" <> '' AND
        (job."listUrl" IS NULL OR job."listUrl" <> '') AND
        job."locationRaw" <> '' AND job."city" <> '' AND cardinality(job."cities") > 0 AND
        NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(job."cities") city WHERE city IS NULL OR city = '') AND
        job."missingSuccessCount" >= 0 AND job."lifecycleStatus"::text IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPECTED_OFFLINE','OFFLINE') AND
        job."visibleInFrontend" IS NOT NULL AND job."isNew" IS NOT NULL) IS TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'JOB_DELTA_PERSISTED_PROJECTION_INVALID';
    END IF;
    RETURN encode(sha256(convert_to(public.job_projection_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
        'schemaVersion', 'job-persisted-projection-v1',
        'projection', jsonb_build_object(
            'companyId', job."companyId", 'sourceId', job."sourceId", 'dedupeKey', job."dedupeKey",
            'sourceJobId', job."sourceJobId", 'officialTitle', job."officialTitle", 'officialUrl', job."officialUrl",
            'listUrl', job."listUrl", 'locationRaw', job."locationRaw", 'city', job."city", 'cities', job."cities",
            'officialPublishedAt', to_char(job."officialPublishedAt", 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
            'missingSuccessCount', job."missingSuccessCount", 'lifecycleStatus', job."lifecycleStatus",
            'visibleInFrontend', job."visibleInFrontend", 'isNew', job."isNew"
        )
    )), 'UTF8')), 'hex');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.job_delta_effective_legacy_certificate(certificate jsonb, certificate_sha256 text, expected_binding jsonb, verified_at timestamp without time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF certificate IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
    IF certificate->>'schemaVersion' LIKE 'job-projection-%' OR
        certificate ?| ARRAY['legacyCertificate','legacyCertificateSha256','projectionSchemaVersion','members','manifestSha256'] THEN
        IF NOT (
            jsonb_typeof(certificate) = 'object' AND
            certificate->>'schemaVersion' = 'job-projection-delta-receipt-v1' AND
            certificate->>'projectionSchemaVersion' = 'job-persisted-projection-v1' AND
            certificate->>'detailEvidenceState' = 'UNKNOWN' AND
            certificate ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion','projectionSchemaVersion','binding','verifiedAt','observedAt','legacyCertificate','legacyCertificateSha256','detailEvidenceState','members','manifestSha256'] AND
            certificate - ARRAY['schemaVersion','projectionSchemaVersion','binding','verifiedAt','observedAt','legacyCertificate','legacyCertificateSha256','detailEvidenceState','members','manifestSha256'] = '{}'::jsonb AND
            jsonb_typeof(certificate->'legacyCertificate') = 'object' AND
            certificate->'legacyCertificate'->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'job-projection-delta-receipt-v1' AND
            certificate->'binding' = expected_binding AND
            jsonb_typeof(certificate->'verifiedAt') = 'string' AND
            certificate->>'verifiedAt' = to_char(verified_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AND
            jsonb_typeof(certificate->'observedAt') = 'string' AND
            certificate->>'observedAt' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$' AND
            jsonb_typeof(certificate->'members') = 'array' AND
            jsonb_typeof(certificate->'manifestSha256') = 'string' AND certificate->>'manifestSha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND
            jsonb_typeof(certificate->'legacyCertificateSha256') = 'string' AND certificate->>'legacyCertificateSha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND
            certificate_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND
            certificate_sha256 = encode(sha256(convert_to(public.job_projection_canonical_json(certificate),'UTF8')),'hex') AND
            certificate->>'legacyCertificateSha256' = encode(sha256(convert_to(public.job_projection_canonical_json(certificate->'legacyCertificate'),'UTF8')),'hex')
        ) IS TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'JOB_DELTA_EFFECTIVE_LEGACY_ENVELOPE_INVALID'; END IF;
        RETURN certificate->'legacyCertificate';
    END IF;
    RETURN certificate;
END;
$function$
